visa-preparation.entry_summary: Visa required unless you're visa-exempt. The Ministry of the Interior runs an online e-Visa (tourist visa up to 90 days); an e-TA (electronic travel authorisation) is for visa-exempt nationals only.

steps.step: Use the ministry's eligibility check to see whether you need an e-Visa or an e-TA.

Apply online in eight steps: visa type and purpose, identity, passport, travel details, accommodation or host, supporting documents, payment, then review and submit. Track the application and download the visa when it's issued.

Enter at a listed point: Maya-Maya airport (Brazzaville), Antonio Agostinho-Neto airport (Pointe-Noire), Denis Sassou-Nguesso airport (Ollombo), Ouesso airport, Pointe-Noire port or the Brazzaville river beach.

documents: Passport valid at least 6 months after the planned entry date
Recent identity photo (light background, head uncovered)
Hotel booking or letter of welcome from a host
Other documents depending on the visa type
